Method of Attack: Mass scanning of Internet for vulnerable webcams and IP cameras
Exploitation of vulnerability in GoAhead web server embedded in cameras
Impacted Systems: Over 1,250 camera models using GoAhead web server
Attack Vector: Internet-wide scanning on port 81 for vulnerable GoAhead web servers
Exploitation of disclosed vulnerability in cameras
Indicators of Compromise: Command and control servers at load.gtpnet.ir and ntp.gtpnet.ir
Nearly 2.7 million scans per day from 57,400 unique IPs (April 22)
DDoS attack against Russian bank on April 23
